entry.title: SHRINCS: an efficient hash-based signature scheme for Bitcoin (first draft)
entry.summary: The recent email discussion highlights an important consideration in the use of markdown for documentation within the Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) 3. The sender clarifies a misunderstanding about the recommended markdown variant for BIP3, noting that standard markdown is advised rather than GitHub flavored markdown, which is currently in use in several sections. This information is crucial for maintaining coherence in documentation practices and ensuring that all contributors adhere to the specified standards. This adherence is not only vital for uniformity but also impacts how effectively the proposals are communicated across different platforms that may only support the basic markdown features.
